text: The base server exposes offlineDownload and autoSyncOfflineStores as Boolean preferences, and autoSyncMaxAgeDays as an integer. Native and JavaScript implementations keep the same stored underscore keys. IMAP-only properties still require their separate interface. The auto-update caller checks both the enabled preference and an explicit imap/ews allowlist; a true default alone is not capability proof. Its age predicate applies only for positive values. No preference or AutoSync test ran.
title: Moving AutoSync settings preserves preference keys and receiver types
